opening.argument: The segment is a televised news interview identifying California's state treasurer and examining the state's suspension of some business with Wells Fargo. The treasurer says he suspended three business lines and discusses the conditions for Wells Fargo to resume state business, including compliance with penalties and enforcement regulations and better practices. Allegations about misrepresented or unnecessary accounts and customer fees are presented as criticism of reported bank conduct and a matter of public oversight. The interview does not ask viewers for money, credentials, or participation; it reports on the state's response to the bank.

citations.quote: I have suspended three lines of business, the most highly profitable business lines for Wells Fargo, in their engagement with the State of California
we want to make sure that they comply with all the appropriate penalties and enforcement regulations provided by various agencies
misrepresenting and creating accounts that are not needed
all fees have been and will be refunded to anybody who had an account opened without them knowing it
